verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms per-item disposal choices (open & scan, forward, or securely shred mail) initiated by the customer via app/web portal, giving the mailbox holder some operator-mediated control over physical mail handling. However, there is no evidence of documented storage/retention windows (how long mail is kept before default disposal) or of shredding confirmation receipts/certificates being provided to the user. Missing for 10: documented storage-window policy, shred confirmation/receipt evidence, retention/disposal default rules.
